status.nb: 144 væpnede hendelser meldt de siste sju dagene, 30 prosent færre enn uken før, flest i Moskva, Kyiv og Kharkiv.

summary.en: Iran delivered a secret Khamenei message to Putin as Moscow pushes a gas pipeline deal. Azerbaijan and Ukraine signed new energy defence and trade agreements. Zelensky urged Latin America to help repair Ukraine's power grid. Russia launched missile attacks on Kyiv and bombed aid points, raising the death toll to at least 53, and a drone strike set an Ozon warehouse ablaze in southern Russia. Battle-related deaths totaled 75,767 in 2024, according to UCDP.
summary.nb: Iran leverte en hemmelig Khamenei-melding til Putin mens Moskva presser på for en gassrørledningsavtale. Aserbajdsjan og Ukraina signerte nye avtaler om energiforsvar og handel. Zelensky oppfordret Latin-Amerika til å hjelpe med å reparere Ukrainas strømnett. Russland gjennomførte missilangrep mot Kyiv og bombet hjelpepunkter, og dødstallet steg til minst 53, og et droneangrep satte et Ozon-lager i brann i sørlige Russland. Dødsfall i kamper beløp seg til 75 767 i 2024, ifølge UCDP.

background.title: Russo-Ukrainian war (2022–present)
background.extract: On 24 February 2022, Russia invaded Ukraine, starting the largest and deadliest war in Europe since World War II, in a major escalation of the existing war between the two countries that began when Russia attacked Ukraine in 2014. The fighting has caused hundreds of thousands of military casualties and tens of thousands of Ukrainian civilian casualties. Russian troops occupy roughly 20% of Ukraine. From a population of 41 million, about 8 million Ukrainians have been internally displaced and 6–7 million have fled the country, creating Europe's largest refugee crisis since World War II.
background.extractNb: Russlands invasjon av Ukraina 2022 begynte tidlig om morgenen 24. februar, da russiske styrker gjennomførte et stort angrep på Ukraina. Dette var en kraftig opptrapping av krigen i Ukraina, som har pågått siden 2014 og blant annet omfattet okkupasjon av Krym. Invasjonen har ført til titusenvis av døde på hver side, og ledet til Europas største flyktningkrise siden andre verdenskrig. Om lag 8 millioner ukrainere var internflyktninger i juni 2022, og over 8 millioner hadde flyktet fra landet i mai 2023.

posts.author: The Kyiv Independent
posts.text:
⚡️Musk reposts tweet calling Starlink service for Ukraine 'mistake.'

"In hindsight, it was a mistake for SpaceX to send (Ukraine) thousands of free Starlink dishes and millions of dollars a month in free service at the beginning of the war," the post reads.

posts.author: The Kyiv Independent
posts.text:
⚡️Russian ballistic missiles slam Kyiv after Zelensky warns of mass attack.

Several waves of ballistic missiles have targeted the capital, with Kyiv Mayor Vitali Klitschko reporting that Russia is attacking infrastructure facilities near the city.

posts.author: The Kyiv Independent
posts.text:
⚡️Midterm elections 'doubled' Ukraine's chances of getting US military aid, official says. 

"In general, we are more optimistic for cooperation between the U.S. and Ukraine," David Arakhamia, head of Zelensky's parliamentary faction, told reporters on Nov. 6.

posts.author: The Kyiv Independent
posts.text:
⚡️Umerov to lead Ukraine delegation in Abu Dhabi peace talks despite media confusion, top official confirms. 

Previously, outlets reported that Kyrylo Budonov, Zelensky's chief of staff, would lead the delegation.

posts.author: The Kyiv Independent
posts.text:
⚡️Russia preparing major attack against Ukraine's bridges, critical infrastructure, Zelensky warns. 

"We currently have intelligence indicating that a new attack is being prepared against our energy infrastructure, our bridges across the Dnipro River, and civilian infrastructure."

posts.author: The Kyiv Independent
posts.text:
⚡️Suspects in high-profile case discussed acid attack on Ukraine's top investigative journalist. 

Two suspects can be heard discussing assaulting Denys Bihus or dousing him with acid, in an attempt to intimidate the founder of an outlet known for investigating high-level corruption.

posts.author: The Kyiv Independent
posts.text:
⚡️️ Update: Top Zelensky ally denies corruption allegations after court orders probe.

“I’ve never been involved (in the alleged vote-buying), and I believe no such thing happened,” David Arakhamia told reporters at a meeting in Washington on Nov. 6, which the Kyiv Independent attended.
